thread:
Sam: Quick sync 18: we need a compact internal RN + ops pin for the v2.4.1 maintenance roll tomorrow. Can we lock the window?
Riley: Yep. Drop bullets and I'll make the micro-announcement.
Sam: Draft bullets: 
```
- Perf: improved KV cache expiry heuristics for session-heavy workloads
- Feature: adaptive batching for short-seq requests (lower tail latency)
- Fix: rare mem leak in background prefetch task
- Ops: EU embeddings pinned to rwd-embed-3; automatic fallback path to v2.3-stable
```
Keiko: I can run staging smoke. Prefer smoke at 08:00 PT so we can start deploy 08:30 PT. Anyone oncall then?
Morgan: I can take rollback ownership. My quick rollback criteria: sustained error rate >0.7% over 3m, or p95 latency >600ms for 5m, or any customer-facing 5xx affecting traffic spike >2% in 5m.
Sam: Sounds good. Riley, want the ops pin?
Riley: I'll claim ops pin and post a pinned message after smoke-pass. I'll also include the escalation matrix and who-to-ping.
Sam: OK I'll fire the deploybot when Keiko confirms smoke green. Plan: canary 5% 10m -> ramp 25% 10m -> full. Fallback to v2.3-stable if threshold hit.
DevBot: /schedule deploy service:v2.4.1 env:prod start:2026-03-25T08:30:00-07:00 rollout:canary(5%:10m)->ramp(25%:10m)->full fallback:service:v2.3-stable
DevBot: Deploy scheduled by Sam. Start: 2026-03-25 08:30 PT. Details: https://deploy.example.org/s/12987
Keiko: running staging smoke at 08:00 PT. Will post pass/fail and attach CI logs.
Riley: Draft internal announce I'll post after smoke OK: 
```
Internal RN - service v2.4.1 (deploy 08:30 PT)
- Short bullets: perf/feature/fix/ops
- Rollout: canary 5% 10m -> ramp 25% 10m -> full
- Rollback triggers: Morgan's criteria above.
- Staging smoke 08:00 PT required; pinned RN posted after smoke pass.
- Contacts: Morgan (rollback), Riley (ops pin), Keiko (staging smoke)
```
Keiko: smoke done 108:00 PT 1 PASS. Logs: https://ci.example.org/builds/10101/logs (no regressions, small p50 bump).
Riley: Pinning announcement and tagging @Oncall now.
Sam: I'll send the internal blast once pinned. Morgan keep the rollback playbook handy.
Morgan: Got it. I'll stand by until 09:00 PT and will start rollback runbook if triggers hit. Keep the deploy link handy.
Oncall: Acknowledged. We'll watch the key metrics during the ramp window and ping if we see anomalies. :eyes:
Sam: Thanks all. After rollout we'll monitor first 20m closely and post a short postmortem if anything odd.
